description: Implementation of the SimpleBuffer class for managing a resizable byte buffer, including methods for reading, writing, reserving space, and releasing buffer slices.

classes.name: SimpleBuffer
classes.description: A class providing a resizable buffer with read/write capabilities, internal management of buffer space, and slice release functionality.

methods.name: SimpleBuffer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the buffer with a specified size.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data into the buffer, expanding if necessary.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the buffer into provided memory.

methods.name: Reserve
methods.description: Ensures the buffer has enough space, reallocating if needed.

methods.name: AdvanceReadablePtr
methods.description: Advances the read pointer by a specified amount.

methods.name: AdvanceWritablePtr
methods.description: Advances the write pointer by a specified amount.

methods.name: ReleaseAsSlice
methods.description: Releases the buffer contents as a slice and resets internal state.
